description: One machine in full: what it is, its status with the time it was read and what that status means, its qubit count, how its qubits connect, its native operations, the hours it runs work and when they next open or close, what is waiting in its queues, its region and place, the provider's own summary and page, and its page on quantumdev.io. Where QDev has published a note on what that kind of machine suits, it comes too, as qdevNote: QDev's own writing, with a source for every claim, and never the provider's. Free.

id.description: The machine's id, from list_qpus or search, such as iqm-garnet.
